Build Shopify Website

About Us:


We are an Amazon Brand that sells Planners in the Office Supply category.


Job Description:


We are seeking a talented and experienced Shopify Website Developer to help us create an engaging and user-friendly e-commerce website for our Amazon brand. As a Shopify Website Developer, you will play a crucial role in establishing our online presence, enhancing user experience, and driving online sales.


Key Responsibilities:


- Collaborate with our team to understand business goals and website requirements.

- Design and develop a responsive and visually appealing Shopify website that aligns with our brand identity.

- Customize and optimize the Shopify theme to meet our specific needs.

Integrate Shopify with Amazon Marketplace for seamless order and inventory management.

- Implement SEO best practices to improve website visibility and search engine ranking.

- Ensure website security and optimize page loading speed for an excellent user experience.

- Configure and manage payment gateways, shipping options, and tax settings.

- Create and maintain product listings, categories, and collections on Shopify.

- Troubleshoot and resolve any technical issues, bugs, or errors on the website.


Qualifications:

- Proven experience in Shopify website development and customization.

- Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Strong knowledge of Shopify themes, Liquid programming, and app integration.

- Experience with Amazon Marketplace integration is a plus.

- Understanding of SEO best practices.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Prior experience with e-commerce websites is preferred.

description:
Space Finder


Introduction

We are seeking proposals for the development of a comprehensive booking platform accessible through both a website and a native mobile application (iOS & Android). This platform is designed to facilitate the booking of diverse spaces and activities, offering an immersive, personalized, and seamless user experience.


Project Background

The project aims to create a one-stop solution for travelers and adventure seekers, particularly in the UAE, to find and book spaces and activities that align with their preferences. The solution would significantly differentiate itself by offering non-traditional space types (e.g., treehouses, castles, etc.) and bundling supplementary services such as catering and party organization, which hosts and service providers can list.


Project Scope

The scope of the project encompasses the following components:


Mobile Application Development


iOS & Android

Segregated sections for travelers, space owners, and service providers

Website Development


User-friendly UX/UI design

Responsive design optimized for various devices

Backend System


Booking management

Payment gateway integration

Request tracking

Database security and integrity

Marketing Plan


Strategies to promote the app in the UAE market

SEO to enhance website visibility

Functionality Requirements

Traveler Section

User Registration


Multiple login options (Google, Facebook, Apple)

Email and phone number verification

Space Search and Booking


Smart search feature based on various criteria (location, date, type of venue)

Detailed space view with pictures and reviews

Wishlist to save favorite listings

Additional Services


Options to book services like catering, party organization, etc.

Detailed service view with pricing and availability

Payment Gateway


Secure transaction process with different payment options popular in the UAE

Notifications


SMS and WhatsApp notifications regarding booking status and updates

Space Owner Section

Property Management


Dashboard to manage space listings and bookings

Option to add, edit, or remove listings

Communication


Messaging feature for communication between space owners and guests

Automated notifications for check-in and check-out

Financial Tracking


Comprehensive earnings summary

Integration with preferred payment gateways

Service Providers Section

Service Listing


Platform for service providers to list their services with detailed information

Dashboard to manage listings and approvals

Pricing and Availability


Functionality to set pricing strategies and availability

Administrative Functionality

Backend Management

Tools for administrators to manage listings and users

Reporting and analytics tools

Category Management

Ability for admin to add or remove service categories

Design & Usability

User Interface


Intuitive, user-friendly interface with easy navigation

Responsive design to ensure compatibility with various devices

Accessibility


Features ensuring the platform is accessible to users with disabilities

Security


Ensuring data privacy and security in line with prevailing regulations

Technical Requirements

Platform


Native mobile applications for iOS and Android

Website compatible with modern browsers

Database


Scalable database architecture to handle a growing number of users and listings

Regular backups to prevent data loss

Integration


Integration with popular payment gateways in the UAE

SMS and WhatsApp API integration for notifications

Timeline

The expected timeline for the project is to be determined based on the proposals received. We aim to launch the platform in a phased manner, starting with a Beta version to gather user feedback before the full-fledged launch.


Budget

We invite prospective vendors to quote their best price based on the detailed scope of work outlined above. The budget is negotiable based on the value proposition offered by the vendor.

- Create a sample set of methods (e.g., 6)

description:
Mobile App Developer Needed


Mobile Application & Website

Overview:

We're looking for experienced developers to build a mobile application named "GardenSwap." The core function of this app will be to connect individuals looking to exchange plants, seeds, or gardening tools with others nearby. The application will be complemented by a website. Businesses and individuals will be able to list their gardening items for swap, while seekers can browse items available in their proximity. Revenue will be generated through listing fees for certain types of listers (e.g., commercial sellers), application fees for certain swap transactions, and in-app advertising.

Technical Requirements:

1. Application Platforms:

• A mobile application built using React Native for compatibility across both Android and iOS.

• A complementary responsive website.

2. Backend:

• Utilize Firebase Firestore as the primary backend database system.

• Implement Firebase Authentication for user account management and security.

3. User Accounts:

Three types of user accounts need to be developed:

a. Lister Accounts:

• Account creation and management with type specification (individual gardener, business, commercial seller).

• Feature to list gardening items (plants, seeds, tools, etc.) with relevant details and photos.

• Pricing structure based on type of lister (with commercial sellers incurring a fee).

b. Seeker Accounts:

• Account creation and management.

• Feature to browse available items based on proximity and other preferences.

• Ability to apply for swaps.

• Payment gateway integration for swap transaction fees (where applicable).

c. Advertiser Accounts:

• Account creation and management.

• Feature to create and manage advertisements targeting users of the app.

• Pricing model for advertisement placements.

• Ability to select the location of ad displays.

4. Location-based Features:

• Integrate location services to track and store users' primary locations.

• Display items and advertisements based on user proximity.

5. Payment Gateway:

• Integrate a secure payment gateway for processing listing fees, swap transaction fees, and advertising fees. Gateway to be determined.

6. Advertising System:

• Allow for seamless addition and modification of in-app advertisements. Preference will be given to developers who suggest or have experience with efficient third-party/open-source advertising systems that can be integrated easily with React Native and Firebase.

7. Notifications:

• Implement a system where seekers receive push notifications, emails, and/or texts about items available in their area.

8. UI/UX:

• Must be intuitive and user-friendly, suitable for a diverse user base.

• Should incorporate the theme of gardening, plants, and greenery.

9. Scalability:

• The architecture should support scalability to accommodate future growth in users and listings.

10. Testing:

• Provide a comprehensive testing plan, covering unit tests, integration tests, and UI/UX testing.

11. Maintenance & Support:

• Describe your post-deployment maintenance and support plan, including the provision for bug fixes, updates, and ongoing support.

Additional Considerations:

1. Fully documented code and development documentation will be require throughout this project.

2. This project will a revision management system provided by the client. Client will consider your preference of code management platform.

3. Please provide references or links to similar projects you have worked on, especially those where React Native and Firebase were the primary tech stack.

4. Give a detailed timeline for the project's phases and expected delivery dates.

5. Include a breakdown of costs associated with each phase of the project.

6. If you can provide any additional features or enhancements based on our technical requirements, please detail them in your quote.

Submission:

Proposals should be comprehensive, detailing your approach to the project, expected timelines, and a complete cost breakdown.

Thank you for your interest in the GardenSwap project. We look forward to partnering with a team that shares our vision and enthusiasm.

description:
Build React/Django Site to manage queue system


Development of a web-based application that handles a queuing system for end users.


Karaoke Bar -


USER FUNCTIONALITY:

Karaoke singers at a venue can scan a QR code to direct them to a web page (optimized for smart phones) that allows them to register for a session.  They will enter their name, email and phone number - this will be saved to a database for future access.  If they have previously signed up, they will enter their username/password and be signed in.


Once a singer logs in, they see the current queue of performers for a given session.


A session consists of a queue that contains all current singers in the room that are wanting to perform.  Each slot in the queue contains the singers name, and their song choice.  The top slot in the queue is the most current and moving down the queue lists upcoming performers.  The queue clearly shows each singer’s place in the queue (ie. How many people are in front of them).  As each singer completes their performance, the queue will update (done by the Host of the event), removing the completed singer/song from the top slot and this update will push to all devices currently signed in.


A singer can choose to enter the queue and select a song from a list, as well as specifying a notification method (email/sms/none).  A singer can enter the queue as many times as they want, but there are rules applied to this (specified later).  The queue is first come/first served unless the singer opts to pay a ‘bump fee’ - a payment option that will move a singer up the queue (this will require merchant API ie. PayPal, Venmo, VISA…)


As the queue moves, an email/sms will be sent to the queue members when they are within two slots notifying them that their performance is imminent, and that they need to be near the stage, ready to perform.  Each slot will show an estimated time to performance.


* the queue must update in real-time


HOST FUNCTIONALITY:

- The host is the person running the session and updating the queue as performances occur.

- They can add/update/delete their personal information as well as their unique song list.


The host logs in to the system and chooses a specific session (Venue, time, host).  Each host has a unique set of songs that they can perform (stored in the database).  These are the songs that will be available to a singer when choosing to add the the queue.


The host page will show the current queue and have the ability to remove slots (when a performance is complete, when there is a no-show, or extenuating situations).  They will also be notified when a singer has opted for a bump fee.


The host can disable further additions to the queue (eg. When the event is ending)


The host page will show all current active slots in the queue; the current bump fee totals as well as an approximate duration of remaining performances.



The backend DB is Postgres.  There has already been development that has set up the db as well as data entry (CRUD) for hosts, venues, sessions, songs etc...  The project requires strong knowledge of React, Django, JS, Python as well as relational database concepts.  GUI design and knowledge of the MUI framework is also desirable.

Artisandirect.us is seeking a skilled and experienced software development team to create a comprehensive business management software solution. - Integrate CRM functionalities into the solution for centralized contact management, interaction tracking, lead management, reporting, and automation.

- Develop intuitive and user-friendly interfaces for all applications.

description:
Bring App to Latest Version of React Native


Hi there! My wife and I built a Pregnancy app called Coconut Baby. See: https://www.coconutbaby.app/


Unfortunately, it was created in an outdated version of React Native and risks getting removed from the Google Play store and slowly breaking on the Apple Store.


I need someone to bring it to the latest version. All of the back end code will stay intact, and this includes the bulk of the logic (notifications, etc).


My current instinct is it may be simply better to create a new react native project and bit-by-bit bring the code into that while making sure the functionality is there.


I believe that some of the in-app purchasing logic will need to be ported, but on this we're actually seeking to simplify to hopefully make it easier.


So basically, the project is to update the existing app w/ all of the design as is, yet there are three new changes we'd like to make:


1. Simplify in-app purchasing: As you'll see when you download and try, right now as a user, you can buy either individual categories, the full library, or a monthly. We can simplify here to cut out the individual categories, which hopefully makes the job easier vs. harder. We'll supply all of the designs.


2. New onboarding flow: In line with #1, we'll need a tuned onboarding flow (again, we'll provide all of the designs) to lay out the options here. Prob 1-2 additional screens while on boarding, and subsequent in-app purchasing changes.


3. Fix a bug: as iPhones have gotten faster, a lot of the gif images are moving too quickly. We need to address this.


Other than that, it should be 90% the exact same app, but either re-created on an updated version of React Native or refactored.


We'd also like to ensure the project has a 10% buffer for those slight changes that could come up along the way.


If you're interested, do let me know!

5. Litter Pages: Develop dedicated pages for each of our litters, featuring relevant information, photos, and details about the puppies. Ensure these pages are easy to update as new litters are born.

• Familiarity with API integrations and third-party services.

• Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and responsive design.

• Ability to create and integrate custom tools and features based on specific business needs.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Knowledge of SEO best practices is a plus.

Jr Full Stack Developer


Full Stack Developer at Robot Sea Monster


Job Summary:


As a Jr. Full Stack Developer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping digital experiences by creating robust and scalable web applications. Your expertise will span across the entire development cycle, from ideation to deployment, collaborating with a global ensemble to transform client requirements into stellar applications.


Key Responsibilities:


Functionality Creation: Develop and document functionalities in alignment with client project requirements and design specifications.

Frontend & Backend Development: Employ server-side frameworks (Laravel/Node/Nest) and client-side frameworks (React.js, Vue.js, Nuxt.js) to craft compelling applications.

Database Management: Design, optimize, and maintain both relational and NoSQL databases. Write and refine SQL queries for efficient data retrieval.

Server Maintenance: Configure and uphold servers, emphasizing security with firewalls and intrusion detection systems.

DevOps Collaboration: Work with the DevOps team on CI/CD processes, streamlining deployments and ensuring application uptime.

Responsive Design: Ensure applications deliver consistent, high-quality user experiences across devices and screen sizes.

Security Implementation: Oversee user authentication and application security, guarding against vulnerabilities.

API Development: Design and document RESTful APIs, facilitating effective server-client communication.

Performance Oversight: Monitor application health, pinpointing bottlenecks and implementing solutions for optimal performance.

Comprehensive Testing: Contribute to unit, integration, and E2E tests, ensuring robust application delivery.

Continuous Learning: Stay abreast of emerging technologies and methodologies in full-stack development.

Team Collaboration: Partner with UX/UI designers, QA teams, and other stakeholders, fostering a cohesive development process.

Code Excellence: Prioritize code maintainability, implement refactoring and adhere to best practices like DRY and SOLID.

Requirements and Qualifications:


Backend expertise: Laravel PHP and/or Node.js/Typescript.

Frontend skills: Nuxt.js/Vue.js, with a solid grasp of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Comprehensive knowledge of database systems, both relational and NoSQL.

Familiarity with cloud server management and configurations.

Knowledge of web security protocols and practices.

Proficiency in API development and documentation.

Experience with performance tuning tools and techniques.

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Effective communication, capable of translating complex concepts to diverse teams.

Familiarity with agile methodologies and tools like JIRA or Monday.

Collaborative spirit with a proven record of teamwork on software projects.

About Robot Sea Monster:


Founded in 2012, Robot Sea Monster stands at the intersection of innovation and creativity. With over 40 products launched for brands like Blue Shield and Pearson, our portfolio showcases our commitment to excellence. Our remote-first approach harnesses global talent, prioritizing collaboration, passion, and the creation of applications that educate and captivate.


What Robot Sea Monster Offers:


As part of our team, you'll have access to cutting-edge tools and technologies, an inclusive and energetic work culture, and the chance to make a tangible impact in the digital sphere.


Ready to Dive In?


If you're a visionary developer eager to craft digital masterpieces, we want to hear from you. Join Robot Sea Monster's journey today as our Full Stack Developer.

Company Description:

We are an agency based in the United States that specializes in redesigning and developing custom themes for our clients. We work closely with clients to create visually stunning and highly functional Shopify stores that drive their online businesses.

Job Title: Shopify Web Designer


Job Description:


We are seeking a creative and skilled Shopify Web Designer to join our dynamic team. As a Shopify Web Designer, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our online presence by creating visually appealing and user-centric Shopify e-commerce websites. Your expertise in design, user experience, and Shopify's platform will be pivotal in delivering engaging and functional online shopping experiences for our customers.

7. Testing and Troubleshooting: Conduct thorough testing of websites across different browsers and devices, identifying and addressing any usability issues or bugs.


8. Stay Current: Keep up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to continuously enhance design and user experience strategies.


Qualifications:


1. Proven Experience: A portfolio showcasing previous Shopify e-commerce design projects that highlight your design expertise and understanding of user-centered design principles.

3. Design Tools: Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) or equivalent, and a strong eye for typography, color theory, and layout.


4. Responsive Design: Solid understanding of responsive web design principles and mobile-first design approaches.

6. Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot design and functionality issues effectively.


7. Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring pixel-perfect implementation of design elements.


8. Time Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Develop an amazing Shopify Store

About Us:

We are a new UK-based travel business venturing into the exciting landscapes of India and Sri Lanka. Our core offerings include hotel bookings and unique excursions, providing immersive experiences for our clientele. We want to expand our reach in the future, so our platform must be scalable.


Project Overview:

We require an experienced Shopify developer who can design and build a user-friendly and visually appealing online store that mirrors our brand's ethos. The platform will initially focus on Indian and Sri Lankan excursions but must be expandable to include other destinations in the future.


Scope of Work:


Design: Custom design that aligns with our brand, including logo, color scheme, and overall theme. (Logo provided and now trademarked)

Product Management: Set up categories and add products related to hotel bookings and excursions. Flights are not part of our offerings.

Payment Integration: Implement secure payment gateways suitable for international customers.

SEO Optimization: SEO-friendly URLs, meta tags, and content to ensure better search visibility.

Responsiveness: The store must be fully responsive and optimised for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Scalability: Future-proof design to accommodate additional destinations and features.


Skills Required:

Proven experience in Shopify store development

Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

Familiarity with SEO best practices

Excellent understanding of user experience design

Experience with analytics tools


Project Timeline:

We aim to have the project completed asap. An initial prototype was built using GoDaddy, but we have decided to switch platforms.

Regular updates and communication will be expected throughout the development process.


Proposal Requirements:

Interested candidates must provide:


A brief overview of their experience with similar projects

Portfolio of Shopify stores previously developed

Proposed timeline and methodology for this project

Any questions or clarifications needed about the project


Final Note:

Our business's success relies on providing extraordinary experiences in India and Sri Lanka, and we are looking for a developer who shares our passion for travel and excellence. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

description:
Shopify Expert to Help Launch Our Gym's Online Store

Overview:


Are you a skilled Shopify expert with a passion for crafting compelling online shopping experiences? We are excited to introduce "Bangtao Muay Thai & MMA," a premier gym specializing in Muay Thai and Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) training. We are seeking a proficient Shopify professional to collaborate with us in building our brand-new online store from the ground up. Your expertise will play a pivotal role in establishing an exceptional digital storefront that reflects our gym's dynamic spirit and maximizes customer engagement.


Role and Responsibilities:


As our Shopify Expert, you will lead the creation of our brand-new online store, setting the stage for its successful launch. Your role will involve:


Store Design: Collaborate closely with our design team to conceptualize an appealing and visually cohesive store design that effectively represents our gym's identity.


User-Centric Design: Implement user-friendly navigation, intuitive calls-to-action, and responsive design to ensure seamless shopping experiences across various devices.


Conversion Strategies: Strategically position elements like product displays, pricing, and checkout processes to drive conversions and revenue.


Compelling Product Showcase: Present our exclusive range of gym merchandise and training gear in an engaging manner through product pages, images, and persuasive descriptions.


Integration and Enhancements: Integrate essential apps and plugins to enhance store functionality, including secure payment gateways, booking systems, and seamless social media integration.


Performance Optimization: Prioritize fast-loading pages for improved user experience and SEO benefits.


Mobile-First Design: Ensure consistent and captivating visuals across mobile, tablet, and desktop platforms.


Upsales, Cross-Sales, and Opening Promotion:

An integral part of our strategy is maximizing sales through upselling and cross-selling. You will be responsible for:


Upselling: Implementing strategies to encourage customers to consider higher-value gym merchandise or training gear.


Cross-Selling: Strategically suggesting complementary products to enhance the customer's shopping experience.


Opening Promotion: Devising an enticing launch promotion or discount strategy to attract initial customers and create a buzz around our online store.


Requirements:

To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:


Shopify Proficiency: Demonstrated expertise in developing and launching successful Shopify stores, with a strong command of themes, customization, and integrations.


Design Acumen: A keen eye for design aesthetics and the ability to create visually appealing layouts that align with our gym's branding.


User-Centered Approach: A solid understanding of UX/UI principles and a knack for creating intuitive and delightful user experiences.


Innovation and Communication: Creative problem-solving skills, combined with excellent communication abilities to collaborate effectively with our team.

Job Description:

Implement a secure video call feature for virtual doctor-patient consultations.

Enable creation, storage, and management of patient records securely within the app.


Doctor, Patient, Staff Dashboards:

Develop user-friendly dashboards for doctors, patients, receptionists, and staff members to manage appointments, patient data, and clinic operations.

Incorporate secure payment gateways to facilitate transactions for appointments and services.

Proven experience in mobile app development for both Android and iOS platforms.

Proficiency in integrating APIs, databases, and third-party services.

Strong UI/UX design skills for creating intuitive and user-friendly interfaces.

Knowledge of secure payment gateway integrations.

Published and Live apps on both Play Store and Apple store.

description:
Novel Vision


The core concept of Novel Vision is to transform the way we experience literature. We seek to build a web application that takes a user-provided text—be it a story, novel, or even a pre-selected book—and generates a series of unique, AI-created visual illustrations that align with the progression of the text or audiobook. We're essentially developing an intelligent visual companion for literature, driven by cutting-edge AI technology.


The main workflow of our application is as follows:


User Input or Selection: Users either upload a text or select from pre-existing texts within the application. Users must be able to input their own OpenAI API key for the processing.


Story Segmentation: The application segments the text in a way that best serves as inspiration for the illustrations. This function needs to be robust and intelligent, capable of making decisions on text segmentation that yield optimal results.


Story Research: The program researches elements of the story to gain a deep understanding of settings, character designs, moods, narrative styles, etc. This researched data will be used in subsequent AI modeling to generate accurate visual descriptions.


ChatGPT Description Generation: Using OpenAI's ChatGPT, we generate a concise, yet rich, description for an illustration that corresponds to each text segment. The description prompt should be adaptable and allow style tuning to cater to various artistic tastes and preferences.


DALL-E Illustration Generation: The generated description from ChatGPT is used as a prompt for OpenAI's DALL-E, which creates a unique illustration corresponding to the segment of the story.


Audiobook Synchronization: The generated images are then presented in alignment with the progression of the audiobook, which can either be an outsourced audiobook file or generated in-house via text-to-speech functionality.


User Feedback and Voting: Users can provide feedback on the generated illustrations and vote on the quality. This feedback will be instrumental in refining and improving the illustration generation process.


Support Option: A function for users to support the program, enhancing the community feel of the application and promoting engagement.


The successful candidate for this project should have:


Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with experience in web application frameworks like Django or Flask.

Familiarity with OpenAI's APIs, including ChatGPT and DALL-E.

Knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, particularly natural language processing and image generation.

Experience in front-end development, including dynamic UI elements for displaying AI-generated images.

Understanding of back-end development, including user account management, file upload handling, and database operations.

Optional but highly valuable: experience in audio processing, including text-to-speech and speech-to-text functionalities.

At this stage, the project is at the proof-of-concept level. We're seeking a developer who can collaborate with us on building out these functionalities, testing, iterating, and refining as necessary to create a novel, captivating experience for our users.


If you're excited about pushing the boundaries of AI's intersection with literature and visual art, we'd love to hear from you. Join us in revolutionizing the way we engage with stories, powered by the latest AI technology.

description:
A cross platform evangelism app


This proof of concept is to give a top level description of the requirements of the project. My requirement is set out to develop an evangelism app that assists believers in outreach activities, collects data of new converts, helps establish them in Christ, and facilitates the sharing of the gospel of Christ.

Key Features:

1. User Registration and Profiles:

    • Users can create accounts and personalize their profiles.

    • Profile information includes name, contact details, church affiliation, and areas of interest in evangelism.

2. Outreach Planning and Tracking:

    • Users can plan and schedule outreach activities such as street evangelism, home visits, or community events.

    • The app provides tools to track outreach progress, including the number of contacts made and the responses received.

3. Data Collection:

    • Users can record information about new converts, including their names, contact details, and background information.

    • The app allows users to categorize new converts based on demographics, location, or specific needs.

4. Discipleship Resources:

    • The app provides a library of discipleship resources, including Bible studies, devotionals, and teaching materials.

    • Users can access and share these resources with new converts to support their spiritual growth.

5. Follow-up and Mentoring:

    • The app enables users to schedule and track follow-up activities with new converts, such as phone calls, meetings, or mentoring sessions.

    • Users can set reminders and receive notifications to ensure consistent engagement with new converts.

6. Gospel Sharing:

    • The app includes resources for sharing the gospel, such as gospel tracts, videos, or testimonies.

    • Users can access these materials to effectively communicate the message of Christ and share them with contacts.

7. Community and Collaboration:

    • The app fosters a sense of community among users, allowing them to connect, share experiences, and seek advice.

    • Users can collaborate on outreach projects, exchange ideas, and support each other in evangelism efforts.

8. Analytics and Reporting:

    • The app provides analytics and reporting features to track outreach effectiveness, conversion rates, and discipleship progress.

    • Users can generate reports to assess the impact of their evangelism activities and identify areas for improvement.

Technical Considerations:

• Cross-platform development using frameworks like React Native or Flutter for availability on iOS and Android.

• Backend server to handle user data, authentication, and data storage.

• Integration with third-party APIs for resources such as Bible versions, discipleship materials, or evangelistic content.

• User-friendly interface with intuitive navigation and clear instructions for ease of use.

Custom Website Designer


We are seeking a highly creative and skilled Custom Website Designer to join our dynamic team. As a Custom Website Designer, you will be responsible for designing and developing visually stunning, user-friendly, and responsive websites tailored to our clients' unique needs. Your innovative designs will play a crucial role in enhancing our clients' online presence and overall user experience.


Responsibilities:


Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to understand their specific requirements, brand identity, and target audience.

Create custom website designs that align with clients' branding guidelines, ensuring a seamless and consistent brand experience across all digital platforms.

Develop wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to visualize design concepts and user interactions.

Utilize industry-leading design tools and technologies to produce visually appealing and engaging website layouts.

Optimize websites for responsiveness, ensuring smooth functionality across various devices and screen sizes.

Stay updated with the latest design trends, user experience best practices, and emerging web technologies to incorporate innovative elements into your designs.

Work closely with developers to ensure the seamless integration of design elements into the final website.

Conduct regular design reviews and iterate on design concepts based on feedback from clients and team members.

Ensure all website designs meet accessibility standards and adhere to web design best practices.

Skills and Qualifications:


Proven experience as a Custom Website Designer or a similar role with a strong portfolio showcasing your previous website design projects.

Proficiency in using design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator), Sketch, or other relevant software.

Solid understanding of user experience (UX) principles and an ability to translate them into effective website designs.

Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to work closely with developers to implement your designs.

Experience designing for responsive and mobile-first websites to create optimal user experiences across devices.

Excellent creativity, attention to detail, and a passion for creating visually captivating websites.

Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with clients and team members and present design concepts convincingly.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge of SEO principles and web accessibility standards is a plus.

Contract Details:


Full-time or part-time position with the option for remote work or office-based, depending on the candidate's location and preference.

Competitive compensation package based on experience and design expertise.

Opportunities for professional development and growth within the organization.

If you are a visionary designer with a flair for crafting bespoke website experiences and are eager to take on new challenges, we welcome your application. Job Description: Frontend Developer | ReactJS | React Native


Position Overview:


We are seeking a talented and motivated Frontend Developer with expertise in ReactJS and React Native to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate should have a strong passion for creating exceptional user experiences and possess a solid understanding of modern front-end technologies. Responsibilities:


Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement visually stunning and user-friendly interfaces for web and mobile applications using ReactJS and React Native.

Develop responsive and cross-platform applications that function seamlessly on various devices and screen sizes.

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to best practices and coding standards.

Optimize application performance to ensure fast load times and smooth user interactions.

Work closely with back-end developers to integrate front-end applications with APIs and ensure data flow consistency.

Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and mentor junior developers when needed.

Stay up-to-date with the latest front-end technologies, trends, and best practices to continuously improve development processes.

Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to frontend development, ensuring timely bug fixes and updates.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and contribute to overall project planning.

Contribute to the improvement of development workflows, tools, and processes to enhance team efficiency and product quality.

Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

Proven experience as a Frontend Developer with a focus on ReactJS and React Native development.

Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, with a deep understanding of frontend architecture and component-driven development.

Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or MobX for handling complex application states.

Familiarity with RESTful APIs and asynchronous programming concepts.

Knowledge of responsive design principles and mobile-first development.

Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.

Understanding of web performance optimization techniques.

Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude toward challenges.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Preferred Additional Skills:


Experience with GraphQL and other modern front-end technologies.

Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, Enzyme, or React Testing Library.

Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and ability to work closely with designers.

Previous experience in working within an Agile/Scrum development environment.

description:
UX / UI Designer for Re-Design of SAAS website (Long Term Role)


Hello, we operate a software website that sells VPN and Proxy Services.


We are looking for a skilled website designer to assist us with:


1. A full website re-design

2. Long term, ongoing part-time work for continual website design developments.


The ideal candidate will have a background in modern UX & UI design, graphic design, and web design for software / SAAS websites.



PROJECT OVERVIEW & TASKS:


1. RESEARCH:

Look at our website, branding, and fonts to get a clear understanding of our brand and colors.


2. WEBSITE STYLE-GUIDE (DESIGN SYSTEM) RE-DESIGN:

Currently up until this point, we have never created an internal design system (style guide) that pre-sets standards of elements like buttons, colors, fonts, components, and page blocks to be used on new pages across the website. This has caused some issues of inconsistencies in design across our pages of the website. In the re-design, we're looking to fix that.


So, we will be purchasing a new website Wordpress Theme that has a Style Guide (design system) pre-created.


The Style Guide (design system) included in the theme includes page blocks, components, buttons, fonts, etc. For this task your job will be to simply UPDATE all of theme style guide to fit our brand colors, fonts, etc. This will make the full website re-design much faster and easier as you will then use this style guide as the basis of your re-design.


3. FULL WEBSITE RE-DESIGN:

Re-create all of the website pages on our existing website using the content on our website and the components created in the Style Guide.



4. CONTINUAL WEBSITE DESIGN WORK:

We will leave the project open (or start a new project) on an hourly rate for continual and on-going design work for creation of landing pages, product page changes, etc.



REQUIREMENTS:

- MUST be fluent in english reading, writing, speaking

- Must have extensive experience with UX / UI design for SAAS businesses (AND EXAMPLES)

- MUST be highly conscientious with high attention to detail.  

- Must be available at least 30 hours a week to dedicate to this project to ensure timely completion.

- Must include the keyword "Burger" in your application to confirm you've read this entire post

Software Development Specification: Social Media Management Platform


Introduction:


This software development specification outlines the requirements for a social media management platform. The platform will enable businesses to manage their social media accounts more efficiently by providing features such as content scheduling, analytics, and engagement tracking. The platform will be developed using modern web development technologies such as Node.js, React, and MongoDB.


Functional Requirements:


User Management: The platform will allow businesses to create user accounts with different roles such as admin, editor, and contributor. Each user will have their login credentials and access levels.


Social Media Integration: The platform will integrate with popular social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Users will be able to connect their accounts and manage them from a single dashboard.


Content Management: Users will be able to create, edit, and schedule content for their social media accounts. The platform will support various media types such as text, images, videos, and links.


Analytics and Reporting: The platform will provide analytics and reporting features to help users track their social media performance. The platform will provide metrics such as reach, engagement, and follower growth.


Engagement Tracking: The platform will allow users to track and respond to comments, mentions, and messages across their social media accounts.


Collaboration: The platform will enable users to collaborate on social media content creation and management. Users will be able to assign tasks, track progress, and share content.


Customization: The platform will allow users to customize their dashboard and reports to meet their specific needs. Users will be able to choose the metrics they want to track, create custom reports, and set up notifications.


Non-functional Requirements:


Security: The platform will follow industry-standard security practices such as encryption, access controls, and data backups. The platform will also comply with relevant privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA.


Performance: The platform will be designed to handle large volumes of social media data and provide fast response times. The platform will be tested for performance and scalability using tools such as LoadRunner and JMeter.


Usability: The platform will be designed with a user-friendly interface that is easy to navigate and use. The platform will also provide online documentation and customer support to help users with any questions or issues.


Compatibility: The platform will be designed to work across multiple devices and browsers. The platform will be tested for compatibility with popular browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.


Conclusion:


The social media management platform will provide businesses with a comprehensive solution for managing their social media accounts. The platform will be designed with a focus on user experience, performance, and security. The platform will enable users to streamline their social media management, improve their social media performance, and grow their brand.
